'''''Kappa''''' was a group of five [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] that served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
They transferred [[Sian Tevv/Legends|Sian Tevv]] and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Invincible (Strike Fear)|''Invincible'']] after they were captured by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] during the [[Diplomatic Summit at Sullust]]. The shuttles were [[Rescue of Sian Tevv|attacked]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], including [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], and the Sullustans were rescued before they reached the ''Invincible''.
